results.title: Niger Says Chinese Firm Safety Lapses Preceded Oil Well Blowout - Bloomberg
results.snippet: Almost 800 meters of casing at the Goumeri W8 well wasn’t cemented, while abnormal pressure — recorded in company documents since September 2021 — went untreated, the oil and environment ministries said in a statement on Tuesday. The well also had just two casing phases, fewer than the standard for the field, Oil Ministry Secretary General Abdoul Karim Mohamed Ali said on state broadcaster RTN.
